1. (Currently Amended) A regenerative braking control system for a __vehicle operated partially or fully by electric power__ comprising: at least one sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit a sensor signal responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking; and a regenerative powertrain interfacing with the at least one sensor and adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor.

5. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to at least one of a front axle and a rear axle of the vehicle, and wherein the application of regenerative braking torque is adjusted based on feedback from the at least one sensor.

7. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to a selected one of front wheels and rear wheels of the vehicle, and wherein the application of regenerative braking torque is determined based on the sensing of the front tire impact event.

13. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to at least one of a front axle and a rear axle of the vehicle, with the capability to adjust torque distribution based upon input from the at least one sensor.
